svg.title: Build provenance: the platform records how the artifact was made, and the gate checks it
svg.desc: A source repository at tag v1.4 feeds a hardened build platform. The platform outputs the model file with its SHA-256 digest and an in-toto Statement whose SLSA provenance predicate names the subject digest, the builder, the source and ref, and the resolved dependencies. The platform signs the statement inside a DSSE envelope with a key that build steps cannot reach. The registry stores the artifact and the attestation together. A deployment gate admits the model only if a trusted builder signed, the digest matches a subject, and the source and parameters are the expected ones; a swapped file, an unknown builder, or a build from a fork is refused.
